Class OffscreenButtons.Button

java.lang.Object

net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiButton
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.OffscreenButtons.Button
Enclosing class:
OffscreenButtons
public static final class OffscreenButtons.Button extends net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiButton
Vanilla GuiButton retaining its configured action, drawing, tooltip and explicit keyboard focus.
